About Dr. Ella Golrang

Smiles Designed Around You.

Dr. Ella Golrang is a cosmetic dentist based in Toronto, focused on natural-looking, personalized smile transformations. Every treatment plan is tailored to each patient's facial features, preferences, and personal style — from subtle bonding touch-ups to full smile makeovers.

What We Offer

Cosmetic Dentistry Services

Personalized cosmetic treatments designed around your smile goals — from a single bonding touch-up to a full transformation.

Porcelain Veneers

Thin, custom-crafted shells designed to enhance shape, color, and symmetry.

No-Prep & Minimal-Prep Veneers

Composite Bonding

Edge Bonding

Good to Know

Frequently Asked Questions

Porcelain veneers are custom-made shells bonded to the tooth surface, while composite bonding is sculpted directly onto the tooth in a single visit. Which option is right for you depends on your goals, and we'll walk through both during your consultation.
Candidacy depends on your current tooth structure and smile goals. A consultation is the best way to find out which veneer approach preserves the most natural tooth while still achieving the look you want.
Timelines vary based on the treatments involved — composite bonding can often be completed in a single visit, while porcelain veneers typically involve multiple appointments. We'll outline a timeline during your consultation.
Every smile design is planned around your facial features, tooth shape, and personal style, with the goal of a result that complements your natural smile rather than looking artificial.
Yes — every smile journey starts with a one-on-one consultation to discuss your goals and explore which options suit you best.
You can follow along and see recent cases on Instagram @dr.ella.golrang.
Use the booking form on this page, or reach out directly on Instagram @dr.ella.golrang, and we'll follow up to schedule your visit.
